syllabus_topics: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and its efficient computation (FFT)
Worst-case and average-case efficiency analysis of imperative programs
Determination of closed forms for sums of elementary terms
Regular languages, regular expressions and regular grammars
Hoare logic for partial and total correctness of imperative programs
Total correctness of search and sorting algorithms
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment. Three tests are conducted during the semester. Test scores can be recovered during the resit period.
bibliography: Kenneth H. Rosen, Discrete Mathematics, McGraw-Hill, 1999 (main)
Jonathan L. Gross., Combinatorial Methods with Computer Applications, Chapman & Hall CRC, 2008 (main)
Ronald L. Graham, Donald E. Knuth e Oren Patashnik, Concrete Mathematics: A foundation for computer science, Addison-Wesley Publishing Company, 1994 (main)
José Félix Costa e Paula Gouveia, Matemática Discreta, IST Press, 2019 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
